messages:
samir: quick intake — triage for a community-submitted model 'citrine-6B'. bench numbers look interesting for chat. requesting legal + quant triage before we put into catalog.

anya-legal: pinging legal. do we have a link to the repo/weights and the license? any obvious NC/clauses? :eyes:

samir: https://huggingface.co/community/citrine-6b — license file linked as CC-BY-NC-4.0 and maintainer notes mention contributor agreement, a bit ambiguous. weights are available but provenance metadata missing.

liz: CC-BY-NC is a hard stop for hosted commercial API. could be usable for internal evals only. need counsel confirmation about derivative/transformations.

marco: quick quant smoke I ran locally (tiny eval set). results:
```
q8_eval: ppl 12.4, rouge-L +0.8 vs fp16
q4_eval: ppl 28.9, many hallucination spikes on commonsense prompts
inference command: python run_infer.py --model citrine-6b --quant q8_0 --seq 512
```

samir: @anya-legal so NC means we can't serve it to paying customers, correct? what about dedicated/reserved capacity customers?

anya-legal: correct — BY-NC restricts commercial use broadly. serving as part of a paid product would be commercial. Dedicated/on-prem customers might be a different legal path but we can't assume. need licensing counsel to confirm any carveouts.

ops-bot: note: compliance check failed -> provenance:missing. Model status set to blocked:provenance.

liz: question: do CC licenses usually allow quantization/format conversion? feels like a technical transformation but could be argued as derivative work. we should avoid redistributing transformed weights publicly.

anya-legal: CC text allows adaptations, but jurisdictional interpretation varies. quantization probably OK for internal use; redistribution or offering as-a-service is the risky part. counsel will advise. I'll flag for an expedited read.

marco: in the meantime I'll push sanitized eval artifacts (no weights) and full benchmark outputs to internal s3 and run the longer LLM-hardness suite tomorrow. path I'll use: s3://redwood-internal/evals/citrine6b/ — will add checksums and log.

samir: action items: 1) legal to confirm commercial rights or request relicense/clarify contributor agreement (anya-legal). 2) marco to push sanitized artifacts + full benchmark (marco). 3) devex to create a disabled catalog entry so we can flip when cleared (liz). 4) ops keeps blocked:provenance until provenance + license cleared (ops-bot). please update this thread when you have any changes.

liz: +1 — added to intake board as 'blocked-license'. scheduling quant follow-up with marco tomorrow 10am PT.

anya-legal: I'll escalate to licensing counsel now and update by EOD. if counsel says we cannot offer this for customers, we can still run internal-only evals but must not put weights on public infra or distribute.

samir: thanks everyone, keeping thread pinned for updates.
